Sunday scheduling by seniority for F1-B associates. Employees who did not take the buy out will not be assigned Sunday work with the exception of the associates who chose a Sunday schedule in 1994.

- To not implement grave-yard processing to the Stonestown location for the term of the current agreement, which expires May 31, 2004.

To amend the language as detailed in Section 9, P-2 from "at no less than twenty-five (25)" to "at no less than thirty (30)".
